0022600203.text: The Atlanta Hawks (7-4, 1st in the Southeast, 4th in the East) host the Los Angeles Lakers (8-2, 1st in the Pacific, 3rd in the West) in the Hawks' 12th game of the season, with Atlanta on a four-game winning streak and 6-4 over its last ten. Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot, fracture) are out for Atlanta, while Asa Newell (toe) and Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, and the Hawks' most recent meeting was a 141-116 loss in Los Angeles on January 13, 2026, with no games yet between them this season.
